limits: Scripted intent and expected HTTP outcome, not exploit success; fictional records and one loopback topology, no independent human realism review
Validation shares calibration/selection; final test quality remains sealed
Fixed numeric lexical projection is not a raw text/body semantic model; hidden credentials are not reconstructed
Wider benign devices/agents, unauthenticated workflows, independent campaigns and real cloud traffic are still needed for production generalization
Same Python bridge before redaction is required at inference; Rust serving, TLS vantage, receipt-time and missing-source fallback are not accepted here
Missing actor/flow may cause severe false positives; inspect sensitivity FPR as well as recall
Rule baseline/OR fusion diagnostics do not execute the full Rust engine and may exceed the false-alert budget
Short CPU pilot does not establish150minute thermal/endurance behavior or50percent RAM usage;16GiB is the explicit ceiling, about52.96percent of OS-visible RAM
Raw PCAP contains fictional lab credentials/session packets and stays private0600; no raw/key/weights/PCAP in Git

Closed flow totals are available only after flow close; pipeline uses past completed client flow context
